title: Research Analyst, KYC Operations
description: Position Summary This role sits within our Corporate Operations team, specialising in Know Your Client (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Client Screening. KYC Operations supports the investigation and resolution of potential screening matches, including sanctions, PEP and adverse media alerts, ensuring appropriate research, documentation, disposition and escalation are completed in accordance with established procedures. The function is also responsible for operational training design and delivery, supporting consistent application of KYC, AML and screening requirements across the operation. Roles and Responsibilities Perform comprehensive screening of clients, related parties, beneficial owners and associated entities against global sanctions, PEP and other relevant watchlists. Investigate and disposition screening alerts by conducting detailed research to determine whether potential matches are true matches or false positives, in accordance with established procedures. Conduct adverse media screening and assess relevant findings relating to financial crime, money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions, fraud, corruption and other associated risks. Review screening results arising from onboarding, periodic reviews and trigger events, ensuring identified alerts are appropriately investigated, documented and escalated where required. Document screening rationale and supporting evidence clearly and accurately to provide a complete audit trail for alert disposition and decision-making. Escalate potential sanctions, PEP and adverse media matches to the appropriate Financial Crime/Compliance teams in line with established escalation procedures. Follows procedures to ensure alerts are responded to in a timely manner (focus is on alerts in a single area). Raising unresolved queries to the next level of support and ensures accurate recording, documentation, and closure of alerts. Thoroughly and succinctly detail the research and analysis related to the financial activity and related entities of Clients, for an audience that includes Management, Regulators, Legal and Internal Compliance. Carry out complex research/investigations to confirm whether the potential matches to global sanctions lists are actual matches according to laid down guidelines. Maintain databases and documentation and suggest controls to ensure we align with regulations. Presenting to partners including colleagues and front office account managers as part of the onboarding, periodic review, trigger events and offboarding processes. Support team members with AML checks. Maintain communications within the business to ensure material issues related to financial crime prevention are raised as required. Preferred Skills and Experience A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce or a related field, together with relevant professional experience. Minimum 1 or more years of experience in KYC/AML. Be effective in finding data from a number of sources/systems and accurately transfer Maintain personal compliance of operational and regulatory risk. Practical financial crime experience or transferable skill. A curiosity about financial crime matters. A good level of awareness of legal corporate entities and corporate group structures. Financial Crime investigation, prevention and/or detection work preferably in the financial services or asset management industry. Perception of AML Risk Based Approach concepts. Sound knowledge of sanctions and politically exposed persons screening systems and transaction monitoring systems. Develop current-state and future-state process maps for Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs and Engineering Services processes using standard modelling techniques and tools. Translate business needs into clear user stories, functional specifications, use cases, and acceptance criteria. Perform gap analysis between current system capabilities and business needs, and recommend opportunities for improvement. Maintain requirements traceability from business need through design, testing, and deployment. Solution Support & Design Partner with IT Senior Analysts, solution architects, developers, and vendors to support the design of solutions aligned with enterprise standards and the ZB technology ecosystem. Research and evaluate software products, enhancements, and configuration options, and provide recommendations and effort estimates. Support solution designs that maintain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements (eg:FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU MDR, ISO 13485, GxP) and data privacy obligations (eg:GDPR, India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act). Support application enhancements, upgrades, and integrations across the QA/RA, Clinical, and Engineering Services application portfolio (e.g., PLM, QMS, CAD/CAE, and clinical and regulatory systems). Project Delivery, Testing & Validation Support the development and maintenance of project plans, including scope, milestones, deliverables, resources, and dependencies. Support project delivery by tracking tasks, timelines, risks, issues, and status for assigned IT initiatives. Support the documentation of technical delivery, including technical specifications, system configuration and design documents, interface specifications, and deployment/cutover plans. Support the identification, assessment, and timely remediation of system vulnerabilities (e.g., security patches, version upgrades, configuration hardening) in partnership with IT Security, infrastructure teams, and vendors to ensure the security and compliance of supported systems. Analyze escalated application issues, identify root causes and recurring trends, and work with support teams and vendors to drive resolution. Develop end-user training materials, job aids, and knowledge articles (e.g., in ServiceNow), and support training sessions and user reviews of new or modified systems. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, and improve data quality and reporting. Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies (including AI-enabled tools), and regulatory developments relevant to IT in the medical device industry. Contribute to business analysis best practices, templates, and knowledge assets. This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions. Responsibilities may be modified or expanded based on business needs. What Makes You Stand Out Understanding of business processes within Quality Management Systems (QMS), Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, and/or Engineering/R&D (e.g., document control, CAPA, complaint handling, change control, product data management). Exposure to enterprise systems such as Windchill (PLM), EtQ (QMS), SOP/document management tools, CAD/CAE applications (e.g., NX, SolidWorks), or clinical and regulatory information systems. Awareness of IT security and vulnerability management practices in support of secure, compliant systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail. Ability to work effectively with global, cross-functional teams, including flexibility to support meetings with colleagues in the Americas and Europe. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results against project deadlines. Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methods and ITIL service management practices. ECBA, CCBA, or other IIBA certification, Agile/Scrum certification, or ITIL Foundation is a plus. Self-motivated, customer-service oriented, and eager to learn and take ownership. Your Background Education Bachelor’s degree (e.g., B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field is required. Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MCA, M.Tech) is a plus. Experience 2–5 years of experience in IT business analysis, systems analysis, application support, or a related technology role. Experience supporting Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, or Engineering business functions in a medical device or life sciences environment is preferred. A combination of education and experience will be considered. Language Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are required, including the ability to present, facilitate workshops, and write clear documentation for global audiences, translating technical concepts into business language and vice versa. Technical Proficiency Working knowledge of requirements management and process modelling tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps).
